_comment: Fundraising proposal for GV Correct (Don Hammond, CEO). Built from the Sep 2026 second call with Matt (Ben on the first). $3.5M seed, angels primary (US-weighted), family offices US/UK/UAE secondary. Two pricing tiers: 2 executive profiles at $3,000, 3 at $4,000. Profiles are executive team members, unnamed. Walkthrough call Tue Sep 29, 2:30pm ET with Freizle.

cards.label: THE ASK
cards.text: $3.5M seed to close out FDA1 for non-surgical pediatric knock-knee and bow-leg correction, fund clinical testing, manufacturing and launch, and start FDA2. 18+ months of runway, selling within 12–15 months. $150K minimum check, from angels and family offices, not VCs or large strategics. Goal: the full amount committed before year-end.

cards.label: THE PLAN
cards.text: Two or three GV Correct executive LinkedIn profiles, run end to end by ThinkFISH in your voice. Targeting the tier that writes $150K–$500K medtech checks: surgeon and physician angels, medtech operator-angels, and US, UK and UAE family offices with pediatrics or wearables in the portfolio. Every meeting pre-qualified and approved by you.

cards.label: THE INVESTMENT
cards.text: $3,000 per month for two executive profiles, or $4,000 per month for three, flat. Six-month term with a three-month opt-out. No setup fee, no success fee, no commission, no transaction involvement.

band.label: WHAT TO EXPECT
band.text: Outreach live within two weeks of kickoff. First qualified investor conversations in weeks three and four, building to 2–4 qualified meetings a week on two profiles, or 3–6 on three, from November, with weekly reporting. One honest note: pre-revenue raises historically take 6–12 months from first outreach to capital in the bank. We can put the right angels and family offices on your calendar well before year-end; whether the full $3.5M closes by December depends on your process and each investor’s diligence, and we’d rather you hear that from us now.

gap.narrative: In under a year you’ve rebuilt the company: go-to-market, pricing, cash-flow model and product roadmap, a team with 15, 25 and 20+ years in medtech, life sciences and FDA regulatory, plus a medical advisory board and clinical testing partners. Investors are responding: of six first meetings, four went to a second round and two to a third. The gap is structural. Your deepest network is in tech, and medtech capital plays it much closer to the vest.
gap.principle: Fundraising is a volume game at the right tier. You’ve already met one or two puzzle-piece investors through your own network. The variable you control is how many more of them enter the top of your funnel every week, until it’s seven, not two.
rows: Strong reception and no hard nos, but only a handful of true fits so far. The consumer-tech investors tested want to ride FDA1 to a quick exit, not fund the data platform behind it.
The $3.5M closes FDA1, clinical testing, manufacturing and launch, and starts FDA2. Every month short of the full round pushes back the launch and the data collection that drives the valuation.
The CEO and executive team building investor lists and working LinkedIn by hand, instead of running the go-to-market and the FDA path the round is meant to fund.
Missing the September to mid-December window, when capital is most active, and carrying the raise into next year on a network that was built for tech, not medtech.

segments.name: Orthopedic & Pediatric Surgeon Angels
segments.why: Practicing and retired surgeons who treat knock-knee and bow-leg every week, and know “come back in 6–12 months” no longer works for parents.

segments.name: Physician & Retired-Doctor Angels
segments.why: Physicians with capital and time who back clinical products they understand; the angel-heavy pool you’ve seen dominate medtech this year.

segments.name: Medtech & Life Sciences Operator-Angels
segments.why: Exited founders and executives from med device, orthopedics and digital health who write lead checks and value a fast, DTC FDA path.

segments.name: Wearables & Consumer-Health Angels
segments.why: Investors in wearables, connected health and parenting tech who read the pressure-sensor data and app as the long-term asset.

segments.name: Family Offices  ·  US, UK & UAE
segments.why: Family offices with pediatrics, wearables or medtech in the portfolio, writing $500K+ checks. Secondary to angels, run in parallel.

icp.note: A starting point: angels first, US-weighted; no VCs, $150K minimum. Check sizes, geographies and exclusions, including the investors your team has already contacted, get finalized with you in onboarding.

cards.label: OUTREACH VOLUME
cards.text: 600–800 InMails and 600–800 connection invites per profile every month once warmed up: 2,400+ on two profiles, 3,600+ on three. Every touch scored and hand-reviewed first.

cards.label: QUALIFIED MEETINGS
cards.unit: per week at steady state (month 2 onward)
cards.text: Conservatively 1–2 per profile per week once calibrated: 2–4 on two profiles, 3–6 on three. Not a guarantee, but the range we deliver consistently.

cards.label: TIME TO FIRST MEETINGS
cards.unit: weeks from kickoff to first booked calls
cards.text: Weeks one and two are setup: ICP, audiences, scripts, profile warm-up. Live outreach starts in week three, and the first replies and bookings follow within days.

columns.label: WEEKS 3-4  ·  LATE OCT
columns.title: First Live Outreach
bullets: A/B tests: surgeon vs FO openers

columns.label: MONTH 3  ·  DECEMBER
columns.title: Year-End Push
bullets: Full pipeline into the Dec 15 close

band.label: THE THREE-MONTH CHECKPOINT
band.text: By the end of month three you’ll have real numbers on audience quality, meeting quality and conversions, and a clear view of how much of the $3.5M came through this pipeline versus your own network. That is your opt-out checkpoint: continue into the FDA2 and Series A conversations, scale to another profile, or stop. The decision gets made on data, not on faith.

bullets: Two or three executive LinkedIn profiles, fully managed
Angel and family office targeting, end to end
The Reef retargeting & Startup Deal Desk feature
CRM, weekly reporting, A/B testing & optimization

buys.label: WHAT THAT BUYS
bullets: A third executive profile adds 50% more outreach and its own audience for a third more on the retainer
Compare: investment bankers decline sub-$10M mandates; crowdfunding platforms cost 20–30% of the raise in marketing spend
No success fee or commission on any capital raised, and the relationships built now carry into the FDA2 and Series A rounds
One dedicated account manager, one CRM and one weekly report across every executive profile
The three-month opt-out means the year-end decision is made on real numbers, not on faith

cards.label: 1  ·  REVIEW
cards.text: We’ll walk through this plan with you on Tuesday, September 29 at 2:30pm ET: where our data comes from, who we target, our track record and how the timeline plays out. Freizle, our COO, joins to answer the strategy and process questions directly. Send anything you want covered before then.

cards.label: 2  ·  SIGN & KICK OFF
cards.text: We send the services agreement the same day you say yes. Onboarding starts that week: the interview with Don, profile optimization for each executive, and access to your front-end and comprehensive decks, so outreach can go live in October.

cards.label: 3  ·  FIRST MEETINGS
cards.text: Every profile is live within two weeks of kickoff. The first qualified investor conversations land on your calendar in weeks three and four, then build to a steady weekly rhythm through November and into the mid-December close.

band.label: WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
band.text: Connect two or three executive LinkedIn accounts to our system (no passwords or login credentials required). Share both decks and the 400–500 investors your team has already contacted, including every first-, second- and third-round conversation, so we exclude them. One 60-minute onboarding interview. A Calendly link for each profile, and a do-not-contact list if there’s anyone we should avoid. We handle the rest.

deliverables.text: 600–800 InMails and 600–800 connection invites per profile every month, from your executive team’s accounts, in your voice, once fully warmed up. Every InMail credit in your Sales Navigator plans gets used.
